doc-explorer-b2af-merged-api
values.template_body:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: Template to deploy AppSync Merged API
Parameters:
  graphQlApiName:
    Type: String
  userPoolId:
    Type: String
  userPoolAwsRegion:
    Type: String
  cloudwatchLogsRoleArn:
    Type: String
  mergedApiExecutionRoleArn:
    Type: String
Resources:
  MergedGraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref graphQlApiName
      ApiType: "MERGED"
      AuthenticationType: "AMAZON_COGNITO_USER_POOLS"
      AdditionalAuthenticationProviders: 
        - AuthenticationType: "AWS_IAM"
      UserPoolConfig:
        UserPoolId: !Ref userPoolId
        AwsRegion: !Ref userPoolAwsRegion
        DefaultAction: ALLOW
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !Ref cloudwatchLogsRoleArn
        FieldLogLevel: ALL
      MergedApiExecutionRoleArn: !Ref mergedApiExecutionRoleArn
      XrayEnabled: true
Outputs:
  APIId:
    Description: MergedGraphQLApi id
    Value: !GetAtt MergedGraphQLApi.ApiId
    Export:
      Name: "doc-explorer-b2af-merged-api-export-id"
  APIARN:
    Description: MergedGraphQLApi ARN
    Value: !GetAtt MergedGraphQLApi.Arn
    Export:
      Name: "doc-explorer-b2af-merged-api-export-arn"
  APIURL:
    Description: MergedGraphQLApi URL
    Value: !GetAtt MergedGraphQLApi.GraphQLUrl
    Export:
      Name: "doc-explorer-b2af-merged-api-export-url"
